The update details are as follows:



Fixed an issue where Portal preferences would disappear after saving and reloading in single-player mode.

Added a building detection limitation when opening the mount's inventory.

In PvP, players cannot use portals while the deployed companions are engaged in an interaction.

Fixed an issue causing bow mastery skills to deal excessive damage if used after a standard charged shot.

Fixed an issue where combining Single Blade Dash Slash with Overload, Roll, etc., could cause the character to be flung an abnormal distance.

Fixed Longbow's Golden skill to properly bypass Shield DMG Immunity and drain Stamina from defending targets. Targets now enter a "Guard Break" hitstun when Stamina is depleted.

Improved controls to allow entering the Bow charging state by holding the key during certain actions.

Fixed an issue where, after running out of arrows and then acquiring more, the Bow Mastery skill could not be used until after a normal attack with the bow.

Fixed an issue causing the Dual-Blade Mastery "Sideway Slashes" to grant permanent invincibility.

Fixed an issue with clipping through terrain when using the Power Ropeway.

Power Ropeway connections are not allowed to pass through other players' bonfire range.

Great Sword Mastery 2 - Strike Slash has been adjusted to: Knocks down the enemy by slashing their legs and retreats a small distance. Press the basic attack button again at this time to perform a powerful leaping slash, dealing critical damage and putting the target into a Coma.

Great Sword Mastery - Assault has been adjusted to: Quickly charges at the target for a surprise attack. Every third use of the skill unleashes a rapid thrust combo. Landing three consecutive hits on the same target will shatter most of their Superarmor.

Great Sword Mastery - Butcher has been adjusted to: A series of heavy slashes, like butchering animals. Each hit briefly reduces the target's DEF by 20% (stacks up to 3 times). Landing 4 consecutive hits will put the target into a brief coma. Gains a temporary 20% ATK boost (stacks up to 4 times) if attacked while using this skill.

Great Sword Mastery - Salted Fish Stab has been adjusted to: Thrusts forward with all might, dealing a great amount of damage and putting the enemy into "Disarray" for 10 seconds. While affected, the target has a 50% chance to miss their mark with every strike. (Does not affect bosses)

Great Sword Mastery - Counter Lifesteal has been adjusted to: Grants status: While active, performing basic attacks with a great sword gains Superarmor; when attacked, automatically counterattacks the attacker and converts 30% of the damage deal into healing (this lifesteal effect will increase to 60% if the target is NPC); when attacking with a great sword, converts 10% of damage dealt into healing.

Single Blade Mastery - Turn Slash has been adjusted to: Concentrates strength on the right arm before unleashing a fatal slash that deals a great amount of damage to the enemy. If used by a player, the target is also prevented from locking onto other players for 10 seconds. Afterwards, the unit and any allies within 5 meters become untargetable and elusive to all ranged weapons for 10 seconds.

Gauntlets Mastery - Revolving Kick and 2-Strike Kick now have a "fast approach" effect when used within 10 meters of the target.

Gauntlets Mastery - Slip Punch has been adjusted to: Effect lasts 50 seconds: While active, normal attacks turn into special punching attacks after dodging. With each dodge in a different direction, followed by a punch, the unit gains a stack of fast stamina recovery. Dodging repeatedly in the same direction removes the recovery effect. Using a Forward Punch within 5 seconds of a Rear Punch ignores the target's DEF. Using a Rear Punch within 5 seconds of a Forward Punch breaks most of the target's Superarmor. Using a Left Punch within 5 seconds of a Right Punch (or vice-versa) grants 5 seconds of Superarmor and a 10-second Resilience Down buff that drains an extra 10 Resilience from the target per hit. Agile footwork is the key to a relentless assault. (CD: 60s) (Note: All directional Punches now have a "fast approach" effect when used within 20 meters of the target.)

Gauntlets Mastery - Defend has been adjusted to: Takes up a defensive stance to fend off enemy attacks. This can be executed without ending the defensive state. Blocking an enemy attack drains the attacker's Resilience and boosts the user's damage for the next 5 attacks, during which basic attacks become Ultra Quintuple Fist and ignore the target's DEF. If the user blocks a projectile like an Arrow or Throwing Axe, they will catch and hurl it back at the attacker (the unit is immune to any damage during the throw-back), dealing damage and knocking them down.

Added a new Gauntlets Mastery skill - Earth-quaking Strike: Leaps into the air and slams down with thunderous force, knocking enemies airborne. Enemies who fail to block this attack will be unable to recover HP. (Does not affect Bosses)

Hammer Mastery - Lament of Earth-splitting has been adjusted to: While active, Crit DMG +20%. Using a normal hammer skill will inflict additional earth-splitting damage to the target and knock them down.

Shield Mastery - Get Poised Before Strike has been adjusted. The bonus ATK now lasts for a set duration after dealing damage, instead of being cleared on the next hit.

Spear Mastery - Spear Leap Stab has been adjusted to: Leaps forward and delivers a fatal airborne strike, dealing massive damage and inflicting a 5-second debuff on the enemy, causing them to take 1% of their Max HP as extra damage (up to 200) and lose 10 Resilience each time they are hit.

Spear Mastery - Overturn now deflects all arrows and thrown weapons that are coming from the front, sending them back to the attacker and dealing damage.

Added a new Spear Mastery skill - Terrorizing Lunge: Leaps forth, striking the enemy with a spear, dealing damage and stunning them. Gains 100% additional Crit Rate for the next 2 seconds.

notes.title: Anniversary Update: "Golden Legend" DLC & Tribal Automation
notes.notes:
Let's get started, Chieftains!

Right now, discover the brand-new Mask from a mysterious civilization, and lead your tribe into a new era!

Our anniversary gift to you: the new DLC "Golden Legend" and the major Tribal Automation" update are now officially live.

[previewyoutube="q-4ofULAgdQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't experienced the game yet, Soulmask's record-low 30% off discount is our most sincere offering for this anniversary and the best time for you to jump in!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/  More importantly, new Chieftains equipped with the "Golden Legend" and the new automation gameplay will be able to establish their tribes and influence faster than ever!  Looking back on the 365 days of Soulmask we have been very lucky to have over 630,000 Chieftains join us in this new world, your support is our most valuable asset!

So, on this special anniversary, we've prepared a wealth of community content: from rewarding community events to an officially collaborated Ancient East community Mod, all part of our "birthday party." Experience the most vibrant Soulmask community with our amazing community members!

I know you can't wait to dive into our brand-new anniversary content, but please allow Maggie to introduce this update's gameplay properly—it's going to be a wondrous journey.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"]
New Civilization DLC: Golden Legend


"When the new dawn breaks, may this Mask awaken dormant wisdom, choosing the worthy to rekindle the flame of civilization."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731990/DLC/

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6e149663cb5d7a9b34e9c32d3628799476b81f90.png"]As one of the inhabitants of this wild land, other masks are closely tied to the ancient beliefs you've known since birth—some are ferocious, some majestic, some resilient; they are extensions of the Chieftains' power, manifestations of your will.
But you heard a call carried by the sea. You dived into the water and retrieved this mysterious mask from abandoned wreckage: the "Golden Legend" 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/76d8a822baa21630b321f85326cf4d0bb082609e.jpg"]It seems so out of place—the moment you touched it on the seabed, you felt the aura of a mysterious new civilization emanating from it, entirely different from anything you knew—Sunbird, Golden Sacred Tree... When you wear this mask, you always hear these unfamiliar echoes from a civilization beyond the shores...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6c96c1bc0daa8443ca6a5cd9dd2387df8872c4d3.jpg"]The "Golden Legend" will be the first mask you acquire that is entirely specialized in identifying and recruiting exceptional barbarians. The \[Bone Discern] and \[Spirit Sight] powers of the "Timekeeper" from the Sunbird allow you to see the full potential of every barbarian—whether their future lies as a valiant warrior or a nimble artisan, it's clear at a glance.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/287504fd08eb03e1b8da4992d4f247ec89464267.gif"]And the "Golden Legend's" mimicry ability, \[Reincarnation], allows the Sunbird "Timekeeper" to return to this world, attaching to your being: all qualities and titles of barbarians will be presented before your eyes with utmost clarity. Who is strong and who is weak will be self-evident.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d986c7af51248a60f40f0f022b6f5ec8ea6c9055.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a6138215cb6e0b2d720170d029f46c562e8ec987.jpg"]While in mimicry, you can bring forth the blessings of the "Sunbird," lost for a thousand years, back into the world—it will accurately locate those rare barbarians possessing extraordinary skill potential. And when you mark any barbarian you've taken a liking to, the Sunbird's blessing will protect these chosen talents from being accidentally killed by your hand.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c251e6e3e063f72ae4ab7455505a7611d1b8d880.gif"]It will be a mysterious mask that allows you to perfectly command all your subordinates. The abilities it possesses make you instinctively ponder the mysterious civilization behind it. What exactly is it? Why did it appear in your world? And what stories unfolded there?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a105d4153d929b717cae628e4e2273f8e097d778.png"]You do not yet know the answer—for the mysterious civilization of the Golden Sacred Tree, the "Golden Legend" is clearly just the tip of the iceberg. You've found several uniquely shaped decorative item blueprints in the mask's database; you can even imagine their glorious appearance a thousand years ago.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/515c02cfacbb43b4d9b0ab5c26465d9d24a138b6.jpg"]But undoubtedly, the "Golden Legend" will completely change the way you govern your tribe, and more of their stories will perhaps only be unveiled later...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"]
New Upgrade: Tribe Automation

As your tribe grows, so does your desire for increased productivity. And so, it has arrived: A fully automated logistics system!

Power Ropeway

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0d8273d21655d5f1b7c29edcda18187c3ec71886.jpg"]Introducing our brand-new "Power Ropeway": Now, automated wind-powered transport hubs will allow you to fully automate all your material transportation! Simply set up base stations at the start and end points (typically between your base and a mining site), construct the intermediate cableway hubs, and establish a power source at the origin—your Power Ropeway is ready!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c35805289e079938fc9fca667011d4f27825475e.gif"]Next, schedule the regular transport of needed minerals and let your tribesmen handle the automatic conveyance of raw materials. You'll have a constantly flowing supply line delivering resources right to your tribal camp—NO MATTER the distance!

And as for ore extraction right from the source, we're making that completely automatic too. The new "Power Mine" structure can be built near ore deposits. Provide it with windmill power and assign a diligent tribesman, and it will integrate into your logistics network, continuously supplying your tribe with all sorts of ores.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f95dcd8b5c1b2b05b25da47acf005daca3c4cd1b.gif"]You can even use it as a fast travel tool, or soar through jungles and across mountains with your friends. Technology changes lives, folks!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/4f9364de1459cc2b961d41f58fed70b97828a144.gif"]
Pre-Building
When planning your constructions, you can now forget about material limitations—let your tribesmen do the building for you! In the new version, when using the \[Construction Hammer], you can directly engage in "pre-building": place the architectural framework wherever you desire. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/98757aebfcda69c04451207922082fd779e7b520.gif"]Next, assign your tribesmen as builders; they will retrieve the construction modules from storage (if they're out, you can have other tribesmen craft them!) and automatically complete the construction. This means you're free to focus on other, more critical tasks!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"]
Anniversary Celebration!

Yes, Soulmask has officially hit its one-year milestone since entering Early Access! In addition to the previously mentioned Steam anniversary gifts, we've also prepared some exciting commemorative activities to ensure that both new Chieftains and the loyal veterans who've journeyed with us can thoroughly enjoy this special occasion!

Official Collaboration Mod:
This marks our first venture into official community content collaboration! The debut "Ancient East Building Parts" mod, a joint effort between @leesiontoo and the Soulmask official team, is now live on the Steam Workshop! Perhaps this pairs perfectly with our "Golden Legend"! Getting this Mod is super easy—just click here to subscribe!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3486111012&searchtext=
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cf7639b8b9cd2ee3453211125abf44b34c904d57.jpg"]
But more importantly, we plan to continuously collaborate with community content creators to deliver even more high-quality Mod content. If you're interested in becoming one of our collaborators, please reach out to Maggie or Laura on Our official Discord!

Golden Legend Snap Discord Event

The long-awaited Discord community event has finally arrived! We know you can't wait to put on your new mask and experience the mystical aura of an Ancient East high priest! Fun is better when shared—team up with friends, take group photos in-game, and claim the black 'Diving Loong' skin for FREE! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"]We hope you'll love our anniversary gifts! The 1.0 version of Soulmask has now officially entered its final development phase. In the days to come, please keep a close watch on our community updates. The first wave of 1.0 content will be arriving shortly, and as always, it will be your host Maggie bringing you all the details! Stay tuned!

See you soon!

notes.title: Developer Update: What Are We Working On Now?
notes.notes:
Greetings, Chieftains!

Maggie Again! As stated in yesterday's update announcement, today we'll talk about the future of Soulmask. But first, I want to explain the purpose of this dev update: Through continuously monitoring player communities, we've observed that Soulmask has been persistently troubled by player-raised issues since the Early Access (EA) phase. Unfortunately, these aren't problems that can be solved short-term. Consequently, some community members have expressed a troubling speculation:

Is Soulmask really not going to change anymore?

This impromptu Developer Update was added specifically to give you full transparency on what our team is dedicating ourselves to during this 'intensive development phase' — particularly the systematic overhaul targeting Soulmask's most long-standing pain points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
About Tribesmen AI

As a cornerstone of Soulmask's gameplay, tribesmen AI has unfortunately become a recurring pain point in player critiques:

I love the game but there's serious issues. Your followers get stuck on any tree on the ground. The path finding is pathetic.

The ai of your followers you attract just plain sucks, they constantly get stuck on anything that is collide-able and dont seem to do their tasks at all because of this.

We fundamentally believe that sophisticated tribesmen behavior systems are the bedrock of Soulmask  — this is why enhancing tribesmen AI remains our Tier1 development commitment.

Our goals are straightforward:

 Preserve the authentic tribal management experience while making Tribesmen's behaviors more logically consistent and dynamically alive
 Ensure flawless coordination where every tribe member seamlessly fulfills their designated responsibilities


You might have noticed our recent attempts to fix pathfinding in minor updates, but we're working on bigger changes — A new tribesmen system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ad358a9701a5caf767caae52d71d71253d3f516f.gif
After that, the tribesmen will be more specialized, and they'll have a whole new path of growth while all their work will be smoother. At the same time we're having them make them more lively - in addition to more movement and behavior, there will be more initiative to do more basic things without having to have the Chieftains do everything himself.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/94b6a1152896d5e60432e78eda1bc41dca63b449.gif
Their...ahem...fertilizer production efficiency is already legendary.

This is part of our ongoing trilogy of core system revamps. Expect a dedicated deep-dive article within the next development cycle.
Yet Tribesmen evolution is merely the beginning. Simultaneously, we're developing a Modular Dynamics System to revolutionize base construction and industrial automation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
About Tribe Management

This addresses a critical pain point: We consistently observe the following issues in community feedback:

You could set up a production chain using the members of the tribe. But it will always require a lot of micromanaging.

No "produce until X pieces are in stock". No "if you need leather to create X, have none available, but it can be made, add task at workshop"

After extensive deliberation, we're developing a brand new system to balance authentic production chains with player experience:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/2ea4b23340be408fc6992e4212d4b4598235fa0d.png
This gameplay module will transform you into a true manager overseeing:

 Resource allocation and personnel management
 Potential logistics route planning across the open world


While the UI is still in development (and the workload is massive), this will become a cornerstone of Soulmask's future. We're working overtime to bring this new feature to you ASAP!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
About Guidance & Objectives

Criticism about "guidance" and "sense of purpose" has existed since EA launch:


No story. There are pieces of general lore, but there is no larger plot knitting the game together. It’s just "go there kill that, make better armor, kill some more"

The game rarely tells you the reasons behind happenings. Some information are not given, or lost in translation, so you have to look around, pressing buttons, to see what they do.

This has actually been on our to-do list, but all along we've been pondering a question:

How exactly should we blend guidance and goals in Soulmask?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/17cd559fb2c2c07e621a11c954c89e4203a5b419.gif

Our solution lies in the game's core — the Soulmask itself. In upcoming updates, the Mask will undergo transformative changes, guiding players from survival to civilization rebuilding through expanded progression systems.

We're also enhancing progression systems — why limit growth to individuals? Stay tuned for how this integrates with the new management gameplay!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
It's that ALL?

Alright, after writing all this, you might still have complaints:

 "This is too vague!"

But truthfully, many of these features are still in early development, so we can only provide a general framework now. We aim to reveal concrete details by April.

We're working tirelessly to ensure this official reveal won't disappoint any of you.

Of course, if you're thinking:

"I have countless questions and can't wait until April!"

We'll soon have an opportunity: This month on Reddit's Soulmask board, me (Maggie) and producer ZIMA will answer all your questions - controller support?, equipment durability, multiplayer issues? Ask us ANYTHING!

We'll announce the exact timing soon. See you then!

Fixed abnormal stat bonuses for certain tribe attributes.

We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of you for your unwavering support and love for Soulmask!

Merry Christmas, dear Chieftains!

May your holiday season be filled with peace, joy, and cherished moments with those who matter most.

Warmest wishes,
The Soulmask Team

notes.title: Developer's Update: Holiday Gifts, Annual Discounts & Plan of 2025!
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays!

We hope all Chiefs are immersed in the holiday spirit and enjoying your time in Soulmask!

Throughout November, we were hard at work on our biggest update of the year:Wild Ride。We're thrilled that so many of you love what we've created. Our 30-day positive rating has reached an impressive 84%—a huge thanks to every player who's supported our work!

This update also sparked a new wave of screenshot boom in our community, and Maggie makes it a point to enjoy the bizarre and wonderful scenes created by players in the new version every day:

Thanks to these players for sharing! You've shown us just how much more vibrant the world of Soulmask can be.

Enough reminiscing about the past—let's talk about the present. To wrap up the year, we've prepared a small gift for everyone: A special festive edition of Soulmask!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
Winter Wish Update! 

Even barbarians have their own rituals at the end of the year. Let me introduce you to our new building: the Festive Decoration Tree!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bb7e1fc503c1f94212ad03159bc078305e9389e1.png

This magical fir tree is unlocked for free in the tech tree. It not only adds a cozy charm to your camp but also periodically grants you mysterious holiday gifts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1102cb5eb65746ea6d4f0592892bf3bd2ace1ce6.png

The gift boxes may contain sorts of furniture recipes: festive dining tables, roasted turkeys, and other lavish holiday feasts for your tribe to enjoy this winter. But remember, folks! These are just props! You still need to keep your tribe fed! So make sure to stock up on "Turkey Platters" in your warehouse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ede587c6eac715b98ad55f76d695cd77cfc2404b.png

We've also added new red-themed sleigh and moose saddle skins. And don't miss the signature "toy" of the snowy mountains: snowballs! You could play as a certain holiday figure, riding a moose and pelting every target in sight with snowballs...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1e74f8938a09a090c47f49259cf19497077d6692.png

Of course, beyond these updates and events, our focus is shifting to future development. While we can't share too many details just yet, we're excited to give you a glimpse of what's in store for 2025.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
Soulmask in 2025

If we were to summarize our plans for Soulmask in 2025, our initial roadmap would include three key priorities:

Feedback from Our Chieftains

In 2025, our top priority remains the same: continuing to respond to feedback from players who love Soulmask. We are more than happy to work alongside you to make this game even better!

Of course, as the Chieftain community continues to grow, the feedback we receive is becoming increasingly diverse. In response, we are exploring the addition of new game modes to better cater to the varied gameplay needs of different types of players.

Naturally, beyond working with all of you to refine the game, we also have our own long-term plans.

The Story Behind Soulmask

We believe that the exploration of civilization, consciousness, and soul remains an integral part of Soulmask. In 2025, we will place even more emphasis on this aspect, from the story to the new world, with more content than you can imagine waiting for you to explore.

According to the established game world lore, a brand-new continent, new civilizations with their own unique Soulmasks, and entirely new gameplay that is vastly different from what we have now are already on our to-do list. All of this will be unveiled in 2025!

Tribes! Tribesmen!

Tribes and tribesmen will always be the most important part of Soulmask. Moving forward, we will continue to focus on optimizing and enhancing all content related to tribe management and tribesmen. We believe in focusing on what matters most and doing it well, and we fully understand this principle.

The automation of resource acquisition and production, tribe defenses, tribesmen AI, and enhancing the tribe atmosphere are all being actively worked on.

We apologize that we don’t have further details to share at the moment, but I am confident that we won’t make you wait for too long! In 2025, Soulmask will be even more distinct, so stay tuned!

Lastly, we wish everyone a joyful holiday season and happy gaming! We’ll see you again soon!

notes.title: Soulmask Annual Update is OUT NOW! Big Sale, New Mounts, Free DLC And More!
notes.notes:
Hop on your mount and get ready to rush!

After nearly 800 updates and six months of Early Access, Soulmask is about to blow your mind with the most exciting update of the year!
[previewyoutube=5dJ3nE5Zo7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome to "Wild Ride" - our biggest and most transformative update for Soulmask. We've packed every feature we've been dreaming of into one massive release. Get ready - this update will revolutionize your Soulmask experience!

And there's more good news: we're launching our biggest sale ever with 20% off on Midweek Deal and Autumn Sale! There's never been a better time to join the adventure!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c7b0395496aaa6837dcfee07ee8704c3c843974c.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/

Let's cut to the chase and dive into what makes "Wild Ride" special:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Mounts, New Ways to Explore

Tired of your trusty llamas and big cats? We hear you! We've reimagined how chieftains explore the world of Soulmask with some exciting new additions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/18bbb44ff8158d7fbe96533a6415a85983b05ab8.png

For us, mounts aren't just about getting from A to B - they're about expanding possibilities. They can be your cargo carrier, tactical weapon, or even your mobile home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/7c60387f4ccfd6dbe8595574095eb201ee29a548.png
Introducing our grandest mount yet - the Elephant! Based on one of Soulmask's largest creatures, this versatile mount offers unprecedented functionality. Want to enjoy a hot spring on the move? Rule from a mobile throne? Share hot cocoa with your tribesmen? The platform supports almost everything from your camp - and yes, it doubles as a formidable siege weapon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/dbd5c644177095133603d6b34dcc633c1d8f497e.png
Looking for something more adventurous? Meet our new Gliders! Unlike ostriches, these beauties harness wind currents for sustained flight. Your airtime is limited only by your skill!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/965e21e485d48b4ac5297b3745224d37257d8722.png
The world feels smaller from up high, doesn't it? But that's just the beginning of what "Wild Ride" has to offer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9ede6e94ac0659e5313f676b6c4c00417dca21c6.gif
And with the holiday season approaching, we're adding some winter-themed features: Reindeer from the snow mountains are joining your stable of mounts! These magnificent creatures can pull specially designed sleds, perfect for transporting friends or cargo through snowy terrain. Time to hit the slopes, adventurers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/befd80c0cf9a5abbc158c14ef30fbb753a58225c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Items - Igniter & Gas Canister

You probably remember the signature move of the Flint Tribe leaders:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3ef70cd63932610a74c7a5e9e3da063a5655c865.gif

Well, after countless battles, chiefs have finally mastered their technology! You can now spray fuel on weapons and ignite them for devastating flame attacks:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d1e1932e378f8ccc21dcd17334b086d5317c8de0.gif
Let’s hope your enemies won’t suffer too much! This attack has a chance to inflict multiple debuffs on your enemies, including defense reduction and slow stamina recovery—happy hunting!

We've also got another tool for tormenting your enemies: the new Gas Canister! It rapidly raises your enemy’s toxin gauge. Those pesky archers won't have anywhere to hide now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Map Events - Plunderer Events & New Boss

Through your fearless exploration, the true face of this world has been revealed to your tribesmen. But you're not alone in your pursuits - the ruthless Plunderers have grown bolder, their expeditions to ancient ruins more frequent than ever. Armed with discovered ancient technologies, they seek to dominate these lands, and their expedition tracks are now plain to see. Meanwhile, the tribes are racing to secure resources, strengthening and arming themselves for what's to come. Look there - another mining convoy moves across the horizon, heavy with precious cargo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ccc82b672588b839a2c36bc85814313e6dbb9da3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/754317916f6e6db3bb1693b87318cbe13b86e1f2.jpg
Whatever happens, this is a golden opportunity for all chieftains - keep your eyes on those new markers on the world map! Whether you're catching Plunderers with their guard down after their successful raids, or stumbling upon the chaos of Plunderers and tribal transport teams crossing paths, we must seize every chance. Don't hesitate, make your move! You'll find massive mineral deposits, precious ancient artifacts, premium weapons, gear and tools, plus those extra special rewards like rare mount cubs and high-quality gliders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/37ac8acc29fe9f5affd3c970cc3f743deb7478c4.jpg

Of course, they're prepared for your "visit." Tribal expeditions come with powerful barbarian escorts (perfect recruitment targets!), while Plunderer Ruins expeditions are more devious - they hide additional guards nearby, ready to ambush from all directions!

Among them is the Plunderers' new leader - Shadowblade, an assassination machine never before seen by chieftains. Using "Shadow Walker" stealth abilities, she vanishes mid-battle to perform deadly blade dances from behind...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/151f3e25ad08e55b72a155312d74e61011a5aac6.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/af2a7efe80896291dce57f3defa5b53a940b6092.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Feature - Honor Arena

If you're ready to prove the true mettle of your mightiest tribesmen, your chance has come. The honor arena, forged through the alliance of the three great tribes, is about to open its gates. Send your finest warriors to claim victory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b46481b09b1719e2ca1c45368d69f548fe5c6f89.png
Elite warriors from all three tribes, sorted by skill level, await in their respective arena zones. From common tribal warriors to chieftain candidates, your tribesmen will face their toughest challenges yet - including some formidable opponents you've never encountered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/853a7595684e4516e513b56cf44985a3dbb4023f.png
As inter-clan competition rules prevent chieftains from entering personally, choose your strongest tribesmen and equip them to the teeth!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/48ecfdd9a91aef71b74675c2b9c106fdcbc2e3da.gif
The rewards won't disappoint: beyond rich material rewards, exclusive new emotes will help you stand out among your peers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/7cf9b3355601bd167929a9e71945c8386881cee0.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Feature - Advanced Animal Breeding

Outgrowing your capybaras? Your farm is about to welcome some exciting new additions! "Wild Ride" introduces the new "Large Beast Trap," perfect for capturing baby bison, giant elephants, and moose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/68b22ee61322c98d0451a96c3dcf2cecc5eee376.png
You can also find giant eggs from tortoises and horned eagles in the wild. Carefully avoid the watchful parents, sneak them home... and you'll have adorable baby tortoises and horned eagles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f30fa165bdfbc4f769cb1161b3f7d7ace62e2e78.gif
These new companions not only provide premium animal resources but add wonderful variety to your settlement. I myself love watching the baby tortoises waddle around camp now... adding a peaceful rhythm between your battles and adventures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/45d5b7a2b75323a00d4fc42a55f9532e9e1909ba.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Free DLC: Cozy Tribe Decoration Pack

Hope it's not too cold where you are! (Except for Chiefs in the Southern Hemisphere, of course) We've prepared a special thanksgiving gift. Launching alongside "Wild Ride" comes Soulmask's first DLC: The Cozy Tribe Decoration Pack - and yes, it's completely free!

This winter-themed decoration pack brings exciting construction updates:

Obsidian Construction Series: Our first new building material, cooled volcanic rock that keeps out every bit of winter chill;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/4e97705434ae2aadc54dc15e97e29394c40579cd.png
Winter Interior Decorations: From hearths to rugs to cozy two-person fur beds - everything you need for the perfect chieftain's winter lifestyle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/e1438ffd61ad581c9ae40d25c23cec1e99df0fb9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5ccb5dda618d1fbe9f4287f1ff4ef025587e8e77.png
Outdoor Decorations: If your settlement feels too monotonous, our decorative plants can bring a touch of any biome you miss. Prefer cave mushrooms or riverside reeds?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3aff1afd9202cbc9bb9afaddd9ee3cdc3f8d1eee.png
Which is your favorite? Whatever it is, you can have it all today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336600/SoulmaskCozy_Tribe_Theme_Pack/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Feature: Photo Mode

Want to preserve those breathtaking views? Now you have better tools! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/68d1a2e155277eb6634d1af3398405bd6797e5e0.png
The new photo mode in "Wild Ride" lets you freeze time anywhere you want to capture memories. Adjust your angle and showcase the best sides of Soulmask's world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b7833a7ddc4b76afd3f5a8e4c18defadbbba43ae.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0e620fc52af13f24fb4ccf8ba1a0e705ad3848bb.jpg
*Love this angle?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Optimization: Controller Support
Yes, it took some time, but we've delivered on our promise!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eb76136bce5149ed8665936eaf065ac814568020.jpg
We've thoroughly optimized controller support for all game interfaces, with fully customizable button mapping for every screen. We hope this provides a better experience for controller users.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/edb3b8502c70fd34e8e3f5c2894c98e6194018e0.jpg
Of course, we'll continue improving controller support - please keep your feedback coming, chieftains!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
New Event: Twitch™ Live Drops

We've prepared something special for all Soulmask streaming enthusiasts - from November 25th to January 2nd, we're partnering with Twitch™ to bring you exclusive Soulmask Drops: unique glider and sled skins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/355bb187435ad087ea7ca4928b0aec96e3a222eb.gif
To get these one-of-a-kind mount decorations, simply watch any Soulmask stream with the "DropsEnabled" tag for the specified duration!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3db9d4baabf4dea1e49483dbe12b5e7450233063.png
For Twitch™ streamers, just add the "DropsEnabled" tag while streaming Soulmask to participate in our campaign and attract more viewers!

It's that simple - maybe it's time to check in on your favorite Soulmask streamers?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
Is That ALL?

Of course not! We have many more updates and improvements. You can find the complete details here:

Added a new structural component: Deck Fence, which can be built on the Giant Elephant deck saddle.

Added four new types of enclosures for raising Tortoises, Armadillo Lizards, Bisons, and Horned Eagles.

Introduced large traps to capture juvenile giant elephants, bison, and moose.

Added wild spawns for horned eagle eggs and tortoise eggs.

Introduced a new beehive product: bee larvae, which can be used to feed Armadillo Lizards.

Added new randomly triggered events: enabled by default, there is a chance to trigger various barbarian or plunderer events from 18:00 to 24:00 in all regions.

Added the tribe transport squad event: enabled by default, a transport squad from one of the three tribe fortresses will spawn multiple times daily between 20:00 and 24:00 in all regions.

Added a new plunderer dual-blade boss: Shadow Blade, appearing multiple times in various locations daily between 20:30 and 24:00 in all regions.

Added a special event: enabled by default in Master difficulty mode, requires manual activation in other modes. New players are advised to enable cautiously.

Added five neutral arenas located in the Rainforest, Hill, Highland, Wasteland, and Snow Mountain.
Added a batch of gestures as rewards for completing challenges in neutral arenas.

Added new slate recipes: Nightstone Series Structures, Beast Hide Rug, Textile Rug, Fire Pit, Stone Fireplace, Blackstone Fireplace, Rainproof Campfire, Luxurious Double Bed, Flint Tribe Totem Pole, Fang Tribe Totem Pole, Claw Tribe Totem Pole, Decorative Greenery (Cavern, Meadow, Hills, Rainforest, Snow Mountain, Wetland, River Valley, Volcano).

New Glider Item Introduced

This is the first test release of the glider.

Chieftains, take note: Times have changed! Walls that once provided solid defense can now be easily scaled. Be prepared to adapt in PvP battles!

Added new glider skins.

Added new sled skins.

A new "Set Additional Storage Box" function has been added to the crafting table, allowing players to select boxes outside the crafting table's range but within the same bonfire's coverage area for additional item storage.

Added Poison Gas Can for PVP combat.

Added a new exclusive Claw Tribe affix "Raging Inferno."

Added new general affixes "Spreading Flames" and "Fire Deterrence."

Added new general negative affixes "Flame Fear" and "Flame of Friendship."

Added new title affixes "The Unburned" and "The Flammable."

Modified the "Fatal Rhythm" affix to grant a bonus when the character's attack hits and stamina is above 70%.

Added introduction animations for five major bosses.

Increased the chances for Red and Golden quality tribesmen to gain advanced attributes.

Optimized Single-player Construction Mode: the player character is now hidden, construction mode can only be enabled within the bonfire range, and construction mode automatically exits when the character is attacked.

Improved the conversion efficiency of the Mystery Converter and added support for converting various seeds, spoiled meat, feathers, and stone bricks.

The Powered Cutting Machine now supports crafting Blackstone Bricks.

Optimized the animation of hammer executions for targets.

Players cannot lock onto targets while using the Dual-blade Flurry skill.

Hammer Charge Attack no longer has a pulling effect.

Medium Traps can now be used to capture small boars.

Small Traps can now be used to capture juvenile Armadillo Lizards.

Mounting and dismounting speed has been increased.

The Repair Bench now supports retrieving materials from nearby chests.

The Mask Decor Table now supports retrieving materials from nearby chests.

Weight adjustments have been made for some structures.

The limit on the number of Ballista Towers within the bonfire range has been increased from 12 to 15.


【Bug Fixes and Optimizations】

Controller Optimizations: Removed the virtual cursor and replaced it with D-pad and left joystick navigation.

Optimized climbing actions.

Climbing Optimization: Weapons are now hidden instead of being sheathed.

Sprint Optimization: When interrupted by hitstun, holding the button allows sprinting to resume once hitstun ends.

Roll and Mastery Skill Recovery Optimizations: Improved for smoother skill transitions.

Fixed an issue where AI would not move when using the Mastery skill "Moon Sacrifice."

Fixed an issue where AI would not perform consecutive thrusts after blocking with the Shield-Blade combination.

Fixed an issue where AI would not use Mastery skills "Low Strike" and "Blood Sacrifice."

Fixed an issue where humanoid bosses were not affected by the Bleed effect.

Optimized Burn and Ignite Visual Effects: Improved for all animals.

Fixed an issue where the dust effect from Vajra Ape of Doom would sometimes persist.

Fixed an issue preventing tribesmen from using their weapons normally after being released from control.

Fixed a rare issue where tribesmen could not move after sleeping.

Fixed a visual issue where barbarians in mines could sometimes be invisible when deterred.

Fixed an issue that allowed Explosive and Combustion Can Traps to be stacked in certain situations.

notes.title: Developer's Update: Soulmask EA Six-Month Progress Report
notes.notes:
Hi Chieftains!

Maggie here, sending my greetings! I hope you're all doing well as you explore the vast world of Soulmask and uncover the secrets of ancient civilizations!

As Soulmask nears the 6-month mark in Early Access, we thought it’s a great time to look back on the journey so far and share some of the major updates we’ve made. Whether you’ve already donned the mysterious mask or are just diving in, take a moment to check out the massive changes we've made over the last half-year, where constructed together with your feedback.

Let's get straight to the point: In these nearly 6 months, we've implemented 748 improvements. Even we were amazed by this achievement!

This achievement wouldn’t have been possible without the feedback from every single one of you. While Soulmask has its own vision, it’s your insights that have truly helped make it better.

I've been considering how to make our updates more noticeable for everyone. So, we decided to show you a direct comparison between the issues players raised six months ago and how we've addressed them in the latest version of Soulmask.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
Solo Play Difficulty

Since Soulmask launched in Early Access, one of the less favorable impressions has been regarding the difficulty of the single-player mode.

We're committed to addressing this issue for our players as quickly as possible! That's why feedback on difficulty has been our top priority. Let's take a look at the improvements we've made for solo players over the past six months!

Enhancing the Main Character

The issue of the main character being too weak has been one of the biggest points of contention since day one.

We understand the importance of a strong main character for solo players. Previously, the original main character felt underwhelming with low stats and no passive skills, making them easily replaceable by any random tribesmen. To address this, we've introduced an exciting new system:

DNA Replication: With just a few resources, you can now upgrade your character’s body to match the abilities of your strongest tribesmen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/047407a85e533e6b5b372ad8b093a856ded1f17f.gif

And the best part? You can replicate their abilities multiple times, allowing you to switch between different powerful builds as you fight on the front lines!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6c06899c25cab4178a5a76ab61728e575ae7561e.jpg

Reducing Death Penalties:

Shortly after Early Access release, Soulmask quickly earned a reputation as a "Souls-like survival game," known for the especially harsh death penalties in dungeons.

In response, we’ve added respawn points throughout major dungeons so that players can restart from checkpoints.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d2c82fc4979f40c01d9405e4c291ba9c0ac4be03.jpg

We've also addressed the frustrating experience of losing all progress when premium tribesmen died. Now you can perfectly preserve your tribesmen with the Perfect Remodel feature - save their best state at any time and revive them directly at campfires!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cceabab8cbc70b6f419d00748bf1e34faf6d42fe.gif

Combat Mechanics Improvements:

Another major issue players faced was the overly repetitive AI commands that could make enemies feel predictable. We’ve updated the AI of most human enemies to make them behave more realistically. While still dangerous, they now use their attacks more strategically, reducing the frustration of facing unfair tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/e6be2db48cb9100e31da1d0edc74a741c904751c.gif

We’ve also introduced a new skill called Recover Sense, which helps you recover quickly from hitstuns during battle. This is especially helpful when fighting multiple enemies, as it gives you more room to breathe and recover.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/acde339fa3c42ccd1840fd0b88ee432734d170cd.gif

For the beasts, we’ve reduced the spawn density of dangerous creatures, such as the Jaguar, on the early maps. We’ve also moved the infamous Anaconda to a small island—so long as you avoid them, they won’t bother you!

System Balancing:

After careful consideration about smoothing the single-player experience, we've adjusted various game values. The difficulty curve across all high-level areas, from volcanoes to snow mountains, has been modified - you can now survive and progress in late-game areas even with modest gear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/47870ff3d4e6008d4d0239b341c013e2e9ff4f85.gif

We’ve also addressed some of the previously annoying drop issues, such as those with rubber and other essential materials. Plus, we’ve updated the enemy spawn mechanics in dungeons and barracks, creating a more balanced and enjoyable solo experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
Teleport and Travel

We haven't forgotten the feedback from our first week after launch. Many of you loved the beauty of our vast map but found the long travel times frustrating. We clearly underestimated your eagerness to explore! So, we’ve been hard at work improving the system.

Teleport and Travel

Originally, we had portals scattered across regions, but they just didn’t feel frequent enough, especially for dungeons. A failed run could lead to long trekking back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a21ae8ae0d664ed7957069da25feba163a36f85f.gif

So we've restructured the map's portal network - they're now more densely distributed at key locations. No more lengthy journeys just to farm high-level materials!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/20cda9f3ffa8fd07824a23157a685998398d31f1.png

We've also lowered the requirements for crafting portals, making them accessible in early-game dungeons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/12c45feed04652c8b3e8d860b90c0babd3ddeda1.jpg

Even better, custom portals can now directly connect to various ourdoor portals and teleport your followers. As player put it, "The subway now reaches your house"!

Mount Improvements

As our faithful companions, mounts have been one of our most discussed features. While many mount changes require more time and careful consideration, we haven't touched the core systems in these six months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6838a43a48365ae99ee5cceda4f8f3f7bc3ddfae.jpg

For example, we've significantly reduced the difficulty of obtaining rare mounts, and mounts can now teleport to players within a certain distance. But I know this isn't what you're most excited about -  more new travel methods are on the way!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
Tribesmen

Tribesmen have been Soulmask's most distinctive feature and most beloved content since launch. Over these months, we've gradually made these followers both stronger and smarter.

Boosting Follower Combat Power

At the start of Early Access, our followers' combat abilities were limited. Over the past six months, we've implemented "intensive training" to enhance their skills. We've steadily improved their combat AI and stats, making them more proactive and aggressive in battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1276633b68e8add89256439c70fe9645681fcf00.gif
Their survival ability has also improved. On normal difficulty, even if you fall, your tribesmen are more likely to stay alive and come to your rescue!

Building on these enhanced follower capabilities, we wanted to do something more ambitious: we've added tribesmen legions. If you wish, you can deploy your entire clan to assault a barbarian camp or even Holy Ruins...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6e668bb868230f45cc6fae0f8c97b8f73f3939b1.gif

Tribesmen Intelligence Improvements

Ever since Soulmask's EA launch, we've been hearing your feedback about the production AI for our tribesmen. We're excited to share that we've come up with several ideas to help tribesmen manage more tasks efficiently:

● We’ve added the inventory management feature, so your tribesmen will automatically organize materials and resources in your storage. All you have to do is drop your gathered items in one spot, and they'll handle all the sorting and storage work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eea531af431cc662c9c47b758d6d22b79d7841d7.jpg

● We’ve also introduced the maintain inventory command. With this, your tribesmen can keep the right amounts of intermediate or finished products, ensuring you're never overstocked or understocked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3ff26083fe3d0dc6c3bf673eabcd9e654c645715.jpg

● Lastly, we've added the upgrade construction command. Select a building, issue the command, and your tribesmen will use the Construction Hammer and materials from storage to upgrade it to the higher tier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5e2f20ec8cdaf30f8d22ba2a7e4766110866030b.jpg

Of course, we still have much to improve regarding pathfinding logic, trap avoidance during combat, and other issues. Please bear with us, we'll soon turn tribesmen into your most dependable allies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
A Cozier Home

We deeply understand the importance of players' personal spaces in survival games. Over these six months, our updates to building and management systems had one goal: making it easier for players to establish a cozy home.

Tribal Management: Quality of Life Improvements

The new animal management interface lets you monitor your companions' status at any time, making them easier to locate and manage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/090959b5bc92c17921771b77fb10d5be15031c03.jpg

Most importantly, Soulmask players can now craft from inventory. No more running back and forth with materials - handle everything right from the workbench!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c0cb49d3aca775a898a29e0dd22fbd9540fdb52a.jpg

More support construction

Next, I'd like to introduce the new construction added to Soulmask over these six months. We’ve always hoped our functional construction would genuinely solve players’ issues:

Mysterious Converter: It can convert surplus low-level materials from logging and mining into high-level rare materials at set ratios! Best of all, it's fully automated - just assign tribesmen, and they'll handle the rest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/94b8f0babea8bcd6cf1d7f419b1bb682fe4e306a.gif

Hibernation Pod: Due to the game’s tribe population limit, sometimes you’d miss out on excellent barbarians due to full population. Now the Hibernation Pod lets you put temporarily unused tribesmen into hibernation, saving population space while not having to abandon anyone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3771b1fd9e77f9012958e3d710c7ad0669056db1.gif

We also have training dummies for AFK character training, treasure chests for secretly storing items in PVP battles...We hope these features let players discover more gameplay possibilities. Of course, beyond functionality, more decorative constructions are on the way, so stay tuned!

Building Interface Optimization

Building construction has been one of the most criticized aspects of our game. Over the past six months, we've made significant improvements, including updates to construction collision, the user interface, and material upgrades (such as the automatic upgrades mentioned in the tribesmen section). We've also implemented various other optimizations. Now, all you need is a Construction Hammer to easily create the home of your dreams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/395b50c7f87bc697b243b2aa53f8642512b957f3.jpg

Oh, and we’ve added “Building Mode”! Press Esc to enter this mode, and you can freely fly and inspect your tribe from any angle. We hope this satisfies some super builders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c6623034486fc2592692ede613fc2af7356205ba.gif

We have much more to say about Chieftains' houses, but let’s save the main event for late November! Now let’s discuss something you might be more interested in: Mods!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
More Variety

If I say customization is the soul of survival games, there shouldn’t be much controversy, whether it’s in-game freedom or community content. This was clearly a weak point when Soulmask first launched. Therefore, we’ve invested considerable effort here over these six months.

More Customization Options

If you got our game six months ago, you'll find the customization options have expanded dramatically:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5929dad59b8931931b3473d491e0e6127813d96a.jpg

From building height limits to load adjustment, from sub-base numbers to tribe population caps, plus that extensive list of optional settings - while it might seem a bit complex, I can guarantee that whether you're playing solo or hoping to run your own server, we now provide enough customization choices.

And if that's not enough, we've also enabled console functions in single-player mode - whatever you want is just a mouse click away!

Introducing Custom Appearances

Many players noted that our late-game gear felt too uniform, with tribes becoming gatherings of "generic soldiers"... So we've added the "Gear Transmog" system. You can now obtain all appearances from common barbarians to chiefs from the game's three major hostile tribes - dress up however you like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a76e3fec45add939606bd0a0d62562ae21255ae0.gif

Mod Support

And saving the best for last - Soulmask now supports Steam Workshop! Community content from mod creators worldwide awaits your discovery.

Whether you want new construction:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1a8039508a206d124955d2691cb30e5928a66be6.gif
*Soulmask Extreme By SiberCat

Or new mounts:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eaab6e5acadae9437881719907f179f86bc48624.gif
*Mountable Bosses By Leesionto

Mods are where imagination comes to life! Or perhaps you'd like to create one yourself...?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
What’s Next?

Reflecting on our progress, it’s clear that many of these improvements were driven by your feedback. Soulmask wouldn’t have reached where it is today without your active participation.

More importantly, we feel this is just the beginning. We're working tirelessly to address many existing issues, and we need your feedback now more than ever!

Coming up, we have the real main event - at the end of this month, we'll bring our most substantial "Mammoth Update" since EA. Stay tuned for more news, which will be shared first with our Steam community. This is Maggie, and we can't wait to see you soon!

notes.title: Developer's Update: Major Update Preview - Fantastic Cheiftains
notes.notes:
Hello, chieftains!

It's been two months since our first major update, "Evolution of Masks," and I bet we're not the only ones itching for some fresh changes in Soulmask!

Our second major update is coming soon, and the theme is "Fantastic Chieftains"! This update brings a lot of exciting features, from the Chiefs themselves to the new mysterious arena, and also the Steam Workshop that offers endless possibilities (you've probably seen our teaser on this already!). Soulmask will be filled with even more potential with this major update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9217efef8a6c1068db475a339f4a6030ca90ca50.jpg
First up, I've got something special for all you bloodthirsty warriors out there—your very own battleground...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
1. New Gameplay: Ancient Dungeon Arena

A new arena is opening soon for the chosen chieftains—loot, fight, and claim ancient blessings in this fierce arena.... This is part of the sacrifice.

——Ancient tablet hidden in the shadows

That's right, a new battleground dedicated to PvP combat is coming soon. I know your weapons have been thirsty for action for a while now. In our second major update, "Fantastic Chieftains," we're introducing new building blueprints to everyone’s mask, including the most exciting one—the Arena Portal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d9c4484be02f157afc20fa1504729c07ec326dbd.gif
On official PvP servers, the Arena Portal will open at specific times each day, inviting every chieftain to enter. You'll dive into a completely randomized dungeon to claim relics from the ancient, mysterious civilization. But watch your back - other chieftains are after the same prize. Only one can walk away with the ultimate reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ac5bf9fa4c6a9f7a49ddf770c901f396f9781e62.gif
These dungeons, remnants of ancient times, are filled with dangers—twisting mazes, deadly traps, terrifying ancient Slayers, and Plunderers lurking in the shadows, waiting to strike. The heart of the dungeon hides its greatest threats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0fb1c5d11ae79123e8e398586f0d56a851167dfd.gif
There are many ways to survive: stay hidden and swoop in when the coast is clear, assist the dungeon monsters in taking down your competition, or just swing your weapon and cut down everyone in your way. But time is ticking—the deadly radiation walls are closing in, destroying everything in their path. Either you escape, or you die.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8fae0d602abde1c7e904569ee504bf7f8395c638.gif
The abundance of rare ancient/mysterious gear and their precious repair kits in the dungeon's treasure chests make all the danger worthwhile—this is one of only two places in Soulmask where such weapons can be found. As for the 3rd-tier modify materials or other rare resources from the ruins, they might be overkill for ENDGAME players, but for newcomers? These could be game-changers—if you can make it out alive, that is!

A dangerous, treasure-filled PvP dungeon is thrilling for some, but not everyone enjoys constant bloodshed. Don't worry, we’ve got plenty of fun in store for those who prefer a different path!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
2. New Feature: Skin Decoration

First, let’s answer this question: why the name "Fantastic Chieftains"?

You guessed it! Starting with "Fantastic Chieftains" update, we're finally making one of our long-time dreams a reality: letting chieftains change their look in countless ways. In the new version, allowing all our tribesmen to customize their appearance. The mask Decor Table will feature a new "Skin Decoration" option, letting you transform into any character from the three major tribes, from the lowliest laborer to the top boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a76e3fec45add939606bd0a0d62562ae21255ae0.gif
Blueprints for these skins can be obtained from craftsmen in the three main tribes or found in chests guarded by BOSS. Once you learn a skin blueprint, you can craft the corresponding skins. Want your tribe's warriors to cosplay as a Retroreflector? Just remember, they won’t come with Retroreflector’s signature "Execution" move...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c97a9bb79167b2aeb7bdc34e1861542cbc93b30a.gif
PvP enthusiasts, a heads-up! With this feature, you’ll never know if that scrappy warrior in ragged tribe gear is actually a top-tier fighter wearing the best armor. Never judge a book by its cover—assume everyone's a threat. We'll be keeping a close eye on how this system plays out, so hit us up with your feedback anytime.

This new feature is just the tip of the iceberg for the "Fantastic Chieftains" update. Brace yourselves for a slew of wild new buildings!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
3. Tons of New Constructions!

New Construction: Chief’s Chair

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d75facf8d7c6b9feb30ea9a2d855d8d0b8d7315b.gif
We need more ways to maintain your Chiefs' majesty. How about a huge high-back chair? In the "Fantastic Chieftains" update, the "Chief’s Chair" will be your exclusive seat, highlighting your supreme status. Just remember to turn off the [Allow tribesmen to use] option, or... well, you might not like what happens.

New Construction: Treasure Bag/Treasure Chest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b12d0addc8a8f78e364cb58dc5c44463de209230.png
Concerned about losing all your treasures in tribal wars? Now, with Treasure Bags and Treasure Chests, you can hide your tribe’s emergency supplies underground. It’s your last line of defense, giving you a chance to rebuild if disaster strikes.

New Construction: Training Dummy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/12d6cad1b382d4e41487026759ff98e141e9637e.gif
I know you’re tired of killing thousands of boars or bison to train your tribesmen’s weapon skills. In the "Fantastic Chieftains" update, our tribesmen have mastered advanced dummy-making techniques. Now, they can create new training dummies that help them improve their weapon skills over time.

New Construction: Mysterious Converter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/94b8f0babea8bcd6cf1d7f419b1bb682fe4e306a.gif
Unofficial statistics reveal that 90% of tribes' storage boxes are always filled with various stones and branches collected by tribesmen. Most chiefs have moved past the "headache of how to deal with them" stage and just ignore this junk.

But what if I told you we could turn that trash into treasure?

Introducing our new construction, the “Mysterious Converter” This ancient technology can transform any material into Bloodstones, Blood Crystals, and other rare relic civilization artifacts! This machine, which once made the ancient civilization incredibly powerful, is now in your hands.

You can even set it up with your tribe's management system to keep your material stocks just how you like them. Too much of something? Your tribesmen will automatically toss the excess into the Mysterious Converter for a bit of "recycling magic."

New Construction: Hibernation Pod

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3771b1fd9e77f9012958e3d710c7ad0669056db1.gif
Ever found the perfect legendary tribesmen, only to realize your mask's link limit is maxed out? Forcing you to kick that loyal buddy who's been with you since day one to the curb? Trust me, you're not alone in that heartbreak.

In the "Fantastic Chieftains" update, chiefs acquire advanced body-freezing technology from the mask, introducing a new construction: the low-temperature Hibernation Pod. This innovation lets you temporarily hibernate any barbarians that exceed the mask's maximum link limit. Think of it as your personal Valhalla—you can store your elite warriors and preserve old allies for a special occasion. You might even use it to discipline your tribesmen... though tossing them in front of a Vajra Ape might be more effective.

We hope these new features bring a fresh wave of excitement to Soulmask. And this is just the beginning—there’s more constructions to come!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
See you on September 26th!

From the new and unpredictable threats in the random battlefields to the diverse looks introduced by the new costume system, and the endless possibilities offered by the Steam Workshop, we hope the "Fantastic Chieftains" major update brings a richer gaming experience to all chiefs.

And believe us, there's still more to come! Stay tuned for more details soon. See you on September 26th!

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from September 5, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 45 minutes. Fixed the issue where the initial character's hairstyle wasn't retained upon death after a hairstyle change.

Fixed Barbarian AI failing to automatically cure diseases.

Fixed the issue preventing the construction of wells and fertilizer buckets on giant boulders.

notes.title: Developer's Update: Developer Kits and Workshop
notes.notes:
Hi Chieftains!

That's right, we've got some exciting news to share with you again! Recently, Maggie has been hard at work with our talented Mod creators, conducting initial tests on Mods and our developer tools. Now, we believe it's the perfect time to introduce these tools to you guys!

Yes, in our upcoming major update at the end of September, Soulmask will officially offer user-generated content creation tool: say hello to the Devkit!

What can you do with the Devkit? What new UGC content can we expect for Soulmask? You'll be able to dive into all of it very soon, but for now, let's give you a sneak peek!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
First up, we're super excited to introduce our Devkit: This is our newly developed Soulmask content editor, built entirely from the ground up using Unreal Engine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5c7e88a43fb9b948b370cc9701e2307ab7426337.png
So, what's possible with this tool? Let's start with what everyone loves—characters!

NPC Modifications:

You have the freedom to modify nearly every aspect of our existing characters and creatures. This includes swapping out models (just be mindful of the poly count...), tweaking AI behaviors, altering skeletons, and even creating a custom set of animations! It’s all up to you—whether you want to make your tribesmen more dynamic or transform every creature into something entirely different. For example,  Our video director Jimmy, who has a phobia of snakes, turned the anaconda into an adorable little boar. It’s a simple, yet effective solution!

[previewyoutube=a7bYr4DS_aQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve also enabled creators to design their own unique tribesman blueprints. You can use our existing skeletons or create new ones to craft your very own monsters or barbarians, complete with custom skills, AI behavior trees, loot drops, and more. Want to bring in a character from another world? Now you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a2bce1ab5586e05716e6490a68aa76833cc8e2dd.gif
Finally, you can place your newly created characters wherever you like in the world. We’ll be rolling out updates for this feature soon. Whether you’re dreaming of building your own dungeon or transforming your tribesmen into something completely unexpected, the choice is yours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bea6fb427d23e3e4fcd07b412b2f8ca6575211ff.jpgJimmy looked for many of his favourite...Hmm

Construction Modifications:

Beyond NPC, construction is another area we’re deeply passionate about. You have the freedom to customize every aspect of your building components—their shape, material, and all associated properties: durability, construction requirements, collision settings, anchor points... you name it. This allows you to create your own unique architectural style and aesthetic. Whether it’s baroque, oriental, or something entirely unconventional that might not traditionally suit a rainforest setting, what truly matters is that it’s something you love!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8af1df75a3b15ec055d578c985d1ea17d8343eff.gif
Considering a unique workbench? You can design your own recipes and functional buildings, and even introduce entirely new features if you wish. We provide a wide range of options for functional buildings. How about a vanity table where your tribesmen can change their appearance? Why not!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/447a2d7d002030358db3edc5fcb4f06531e30819.jpg
Item/Gear Modifications:

Want to create your own items? Absolutely! We support custom creations for nearly all item types in Soulmask. You can define their effects using GE, set the animations for item usage, and adjust almost every post-use mechanic you can think of. I know some of you are eager to turn the portal into a usable item...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/257fed734ef72d9280ce9b1d75f4763e9aedcbe8.gif
How about a brand-new weapon or piece of armor? You have complete creative freedom! From designing the recipe and choosing the equipment slot, to customizing character animations and fine-tuning damage parameters, you can create a weapon that’s entirely your own—or even introduce a completely new weapon type! I heard someone’s interested in developing gunpowder weapons...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3c992db0b089ecf6e390e3aecc5095c5f625b898.gif
Or maybe you're thinking of designing a new saddle? The Devkit allows you to fully customize mount saddles, including animations for mounting and dismounting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/af69749b1ea1f9a3b2d396b275e2755214212aa4.jpg
Of course, all of these creations can be tied to recipes. You can set up crafting stations, determine the required proficiency levels, and assign quality tiers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9edc7a07f71c2544a016d4c2ab7343c65662bb5e.jpg

What else is there?

If we were to list every feature of the Devkit, this developer log would turn into a ten-page manual (which, by the way, we do have!). Instead, I want to offer you a glimpse of the endless possibilities this tool provides—from crafting entirely new creatures and levels to designing whole new maps. Our goal is to give creators the freedom to bring any idea to life.

Keep in mind that the current version is still in testing, and we’ll continue to improve it based on feedback from creators like you. If you’re eager to start testing the tools and creating Mods today, we’d love to have you join our dedicated Mod creator Discord channel.

Now, where can you experience all the amazing creations from the community? 

That’s right—we’ve partnered with Steam to launch our very own Workshop alongside the Devkit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d484947eaedb2b5bae321a01f60891eea62db6a4.png
Just like other Steam Workshops, we’re committed to making sure you can upload and share all the content you create with fellow Soulmask players. Whether it’s a burly sailor or a metallic giraffe, let your imagination run wild!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6f3fcb3372ac4bf145f87ab120d09619871722cb.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png
One last thing...

Lastly, let’s circle back to the most important question:
What Mods do you want to see on the Steam Workshop?

The comments section is the best place to share your thoughts and ideas! Tell us what Mods you’re most excited to see, and who knows? Maybe our creators will find some inspiration from your suggestions!

And remember, the Workshop is just the beginning of what's coming in our big September update. We've got mysterious ancient battlefields with hidden treasures, cool new tech from upgraded masks... but we'll spill the beans on all that good stuff real soon.

This is Maggie signing off. Remember to share your feedback and ideas. Soulmask needs you to become even better! See you next time!
